## Description

Briefly describe the change and why it is needed. If this resolves an issue, link it below.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an incorrect calculation or UI glitch)
- [ ] New tool or calculator addition
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement or refactor
- [ ] Translation / accessibility enhancement

## Affected Areas

- [ ] Calculator / Tool logic (e.g. `src/components/calculators/...`)
- [ ] Video Player / IPTV experience
- [ ] SEO / Metadata / Sitemap
- [ ] Core layout / Navigation / Theme
- [ ] Other:

## Verification Checklist

Please ensure all checks pass before submitting:

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes with 0 TypeScript / lint errors.
- [ ] `npm run test:seo` passes (verifies tool IDs, slugs, and schema markup).
- [ ] `npm run sitemap` passes and updates indexable routes.
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds without bundle compilation errors.
- [ ] Verified manually in a local browser (`npm run dev`).
- [ ] No private secrets, personal keys, or credentials committed.
